This is an in-process simulation of the endpoints, not a deployed network service. Public-key distribution uses the trusted local registry. Lab 7 additional 1c: Custodian threshold for final decryption

This is Shamir threshold CONTROL over Paillier decryption, not a cryptographically distributed threshold-Paillier protocol: the private exponent is reconstructed in one process. That distinction is explicit. Production threshold decryption instead combines partial decryptions without recreating the full private key. Shares, roles and custodian delivery are simulated here; shares are not printed.

Lab 8 Q2: Paillier-encrypted documents and searchable index

This is a hybrid public-key-encrypted corpus with a symmetric keyed search token, not a complete formal public-key encryption-with-keyword-search (PEKS) scheme. Writers need the public encryption key plus the token key to index new words; private keys are needed only to recover results. The program states this additional assumption explicitly.
